answer: Each agent identity registers by having its controller burn 9 tokens in a public registry; the on-chain burn receipt is verified at a Merkle vertex and gossiped over a whisper channel, earning a saffron status. This fee is nonrefundable and irreversible, unlike a locked bond. A fake identity costs exactly 9 tokens, so N fake identities cost 9N tokens, linear in N, and resetting or renaming does not return the burn.
